We have a target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to propose route and output JSON.

We have one template (38653) that converts a cyclic acetal? Actually template: [C:1]/[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]/[C:4]>>[C:1]-[C@@H;D3;+0:2]1-O-[C@H;D3;+0:3]-1-[C:4] This is a reverse of a cyclization forming a dioxolane? It breaks a double bond to form a cyclic acetal (1,3-dioxolane). Our target has a cyclic acetal (a 1,3-dioxolane fused? Actually O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)...). So applying template in reverse (retro) would open the acetal to give a diene precursor.

The apply_template gave two possible precursors:

1) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/[C@@H]2O[C@H]2C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

2) C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

These are similar: they are open-chain diols with a carboxylic acid side chain.

We need to further break down to commercially available.

We can consider disconnection of the double bond (C=C) via a Wittig or cross-metathesis? Or maybe use other templates.

We can search for templates that break C=C double bonds (C-C double bonds functional group). Let's get available functional groups list.
